summary.name: Apache Directory Studio
summary.one_liner: An Eclipse-based LDAP browser and directory client from the Apache Directory project, with editors for LDIF, schema, ACI and embedded ApacheDS configuration.
use_cases: Browse and edit entries in an LDAP or Active Directory server
Inspect and edit LDAP schema definitions
Configure an embedded or ApacheDS directory server
Export LDAP schema to OpenLDAP format
Use LDAP tooling inside the Eclipse IDE
summary.what_it_does: Apache Directory Studio is an LDAP browser and directory client built on Eclipse. The page lists feature areas including an LDAP Browser, LDIF Editor, Schema Editor, Embedded ApacheDS, ApacheDS Configuration, ACI Editor and internationalization. It can be run as a standalone RCP application or installed as a plugin in Eclipse via an update site. Release notes on the page mention connection password storage in a keystore, Active Directory DN handling, text and hex value editors, and CSV export. The page is a release news listing for versions 2.0-M5 through 2.0.0-M17.
notable: Standalone RCP app or Eclipse plugin via update site
Includes an ApacheDS configuration editor and embedded ApacheDS
Stores connection passwords in a password-protected keystore (2.0-M7 onward)
Fixed a CSV export command injection vulnerability (CVE-2015-5349) in 2.0-M10
caveats: Latest release listed on the page is 2.0.0-M17 (July 2021), a milestone pre-release
Backward incompatibility noted in 2.0-M14: existing ApacheDS 2.0.0-M24 servers did not work after update
Some past bugs involved crashes on macOS and Linux, now fixed in later releases
